name: Median Completion Characterizes MCP Netlike Partial Cubes
statement: A netlike completion $\widehat G$ is median exactly when $G$ has the median-cycle property. In that case $\widehat G$ is a minimal median graph containing $G$ isometrically. Conversely, every MCP netlike partial cube is obtained from a median graph by deleting the specified maximal finite hypercubes.
